notes.title: Update: Scrub Game
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="vgfD3ubX-h4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]New Mode - Scrub Game[/b][/p][p]Inspired by deadly game shows where only one can win.[/p][p]You’ll face a variety of randomized challenges — from Red Light, Green Light and the Glass Bridge to shootouts and tractor battles with cannons.[/p][p]The mode supports 2–16 players. Every eliminated player increases the prize pool, and the last one standing takes it all.[/p][p]New maps are available not only in Scrub Game but also in regular matches, including solo. Earn achievements by completing them.[/p][p]Enter the ultimate deadly tournament of Hand Simulator and unlock your winner's badge. May the power of your hands be with you![/p]

notes.title: Hand Simulator: Survival
notes.content:
17.12.2019 A new game from HFM Games will be released called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/924140]Hand Simulator: Survival[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29475639/4a99259e36d03f4e69711c5f8509c6f3ae55ed19.jpg[/img]

The player controller is redesigned in favor of moving the character and there is no way to release this as an update to the current version of the game, so it's in the form of a separate game with its own control nuances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29475639/bd76abb152fdeffc497086b7a5445e006d4f4573.jpg[/img]

Build your own house with your own hands to hide from dangerous animals at night! Try to survive on a wild island in all available ways!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29475639/ad0970e16773a65805b02887c8e6b56a0189475d.jpg[/img]

We are waiting for you on the game page Hand Simulator: Survival 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/924140

notes.title: Christmas fixes and improvements!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29475639/84807f26ebce842dfb8d5743a8247820d227bbe8.jpg[/img]

[h1] Changes: [/h1]
[list]
[*]Santa Claus clothing
[*]Eye movement has become more natural
[*]At the level of Bomb removed the clash of hands between players
[*]Changed the position of the holster at the level of the Gunfighter
[*]Increased angle of rotation of brushes
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the player not to die when hit in the head
[*]Reworked a blow from a bullet hit a person
[*]Hunter85 weapons removed from random
[*]You can charge several rounds in Magmum, they do not fly out when fired
[*]Improved rendering of blood and bullet marks
[*]In VR mode there is no dizziness, the camera is fixed
[*]In VR mode, when you die, you get pain in the form of dizziness
[*]In VR mode, the cursor is now over the drop-down menu
[/ list]

P.S. If you experience a significant decrease in FPS, when someone comes out or enters the room (or something else), please write to us the characteristics of your hardware, especially your microphone model, to our group in personal messages https://vk.com/hfmgames. All the new 2019 year!

notes.title: Fixes and improvements
notes.content:
Fixed incorrect rating display.  
Now you can not sit down if you are not allowed to walk on a level.  
Fixed a bug that caused blood to appear when hit, but the player did not die.  
The player's head in VR mode is synchronized with the helmet.  
Fixed camera flicker when loading a level.  
Other minor fixes. 
  
P.S. Write in the comments your suggestions for improving the game and found bugs.

notes.title: Fixes and improvements
notes.content:
Fixed animation sniper rifle
Increased likelihood of biting on fishing
Animation of the trigger from the revolver
New weapons in Shooting
All kill reports are now shown to the right
Fixed spectacles in Shooting
The blood from the shot remains on the person
Blood on objects does not light up on a person
Fixed a bug that did not give out achievements in Gunfighter and Spinners

notes.title: Fixes and improvements
notes.content:
Fixed incorrect display of clothes on the character.  
Changes in the spawn system of players, corrects the black screen after downloading.  
After loading the level in front of the spawner, there is an intermediate camera that allows you to see what is happening in the room (it may be a bit annoying, but will allow to see all the bugs if they are).  
The noise of the sea was reduced at the level of "Fishing".  
Changed the image of achivka, which is given when burning in a tank.  
Fixed a count at the start of the round.  
Waiting time spawn at a level depends on the number of players.  
Increased time after death before switching to a common camera.  
Improved overview when driving in a tank.

If no authorization Steam, you can play in single player mode. 
In VR appeared the main menu. 
Reset center VR on the R button in the main menu. 
People do not pass through the bar in the Last Hero.

If not connected 5 seconds, then gives an error and goes back to the menu. 
When you kill one enemy, and others out of the game, then you win.
Changed the background sound fishing. 
Hand at the shooting range do not pass through the table. 
The rod is now a little more stable.
